claims.head: Don’t blink and you still might miss the shots
claims.call: The game runs at fewer than 77.5 shots per 60 at 5-on-5, slower than either team’s usual.
claims.body: Ottawa plays some of the league’s slowest games, and so does Philadelphia. We think this one is even quieter than either team’s usual.

claims.gist: Both teams play slow, low-event hockey.

claims.body: The Senators and the Flyers are both among the league’s heaviest hitters, even after adjusting for each arena’s scorer. Keep your head up.

claims.head: The Senators hound the puck; the Flyers sit back
claims.body: The Senators are one of the league’s best for forecheck pressure, at the hounding end; the Flyers are near the bottom of the league, at the passive end. Expect that gap to show.
claims.gist: The Senators and the Flyers sit at opposite ends for forecheck pressure.
claims.call: The Senators put more forecheck pressure on than the Flyers.
